082 * Utility class for working with {@link RowSet}s and {@link ResultSet}s.
083 * Some methods for converting to/from text from/to objects according
084 * to database type. Several convenience methods for accessing metadata.

088public class RowSetOps {

095  /**
096   * Inserts the context of the insert row into this {@linkplain ResultSet}
097   * and into the database. Handle CachedRowSet.
098   * @param resultSet
099   * @throws SQLException
100   */
101  public static void insertRow(ResultSet resultSet) throws SQLException {
102    resultSet.insertRow();
103    if (!(resultSet instanceof CachedRowSet crs))
104      return;
105
106    logger.log(DEBUG, "using CachedRowSet");
107    resultSet.moveToCurrentRow();
108    try {
109      RowSetState.acceptCachedRowSetChanges(crs);
110    } catch (SyncProviderException ex) {
111      //
112      // TODO: test CRS undoInsert after accept changes
113      //
114      crs.undoInsert();
115      throw ex;
116    }
117  }
118
119  private static class ResetRowPosition {
120    SQLException ex;
121
122    @SuppressWarnings("ResultOfObjectAllocationIgnored")
123    static void doit(ResultSet rs, int targetRow) {
124      new ResetRowPosition(rs, targetRow);
125    }
126
127    static void doit(ResultSet rs, int targetRow, boolean mayThrow) throws SQLException {
128      ResetRowPosition rrp = new ResetRowPosition(rs, targetRow);
129      if (mayThrow && rrp.ex != null)
130        throw rrp.ex;
131    }
132
133    ResetRowPosition(ResultSet rs, int targetRow) {
134      try {
135        rs.absolute(targetRow);
136      } catch (SQLException ex01) {
137        logger.log(ERROR, "resetting row after acceptChanges", ex01);
138        this.ex = ex01;
139      }
140    }
141  }
142
143  /**
144   * Updates the underlying database with the new contents of the current row
145   * of this {@linkplain ResultSet} object. Handle CachedRowSet.
146   * @param resultSet
147   * @throws SQLException
148   */
149  @SuppressWarnings("UseOfSystemOutOrSystemErr")
150  public static void updateRow(ResultSet resultSet) throws SQLException {
151    resultSet.updateRow();
152    if (!(resultSet instanceof CachedRowSet crs))
153      return;
154
155    final int maxTry = 2;
156    List<ConflictRow> conflictRows = null;
157    SyncProviderException srEx = null;
158    int currentRow = resultSet.getRow();
159
160    int tryCount = 1;
161    for (; tryCount <= maxTry; ++tryCount) {
162      logger.log(DEBUG, sf("CachedRowSet.acceptChanges: try %d", tryCount));
163      try {
164        RowSetState.acceptCachedRowSetChanges(crs);
165        ResetRowPosition.doit(resultSet, currentRow, true);
166        break;
167      } catch (SyncProviderException syncEx) {
168        if (Boolean.TRUE) {
169          // Just log and re-throw the exception and
170          // try looping to do it again and see how conflicts go.
171          // In a real-life implementation, collect the conflicts
172          // and imediately re-run commit. Then use the collected
173          // conflicts for the UI to pick and chose, then use
174          // UI results to resolve.
175          List<ConflictRow> cRows = Utils.collectConflictNoThrow(syncEx.getSyncResolver(), crs);
176          Utils.dumpConflict((s) -> logger.log(DEBUG, s), cRows);
177          Utils.dumpConflict((s) -> System.err.printf("%s\n", s), cRows);
178          if (conflictRows == null) {
179            conflictRows = cRows;
180            continue;
181          }
182
183          // The following only guaranteed in controlled/debug situation.
184          if (!Objects.equals(conflictRows, cRows))
185            throw new IllegalStateException("Conflicts should be equal");
186
187          ResetRowPosition.doit(resultSet, currentRow);
188          throw syncEx;
189        }
190        // ============================================================
191
192        srEx = syncEx;
193        //
194        // TODO: test CRS undoUpdate after accept changes
195        //
196        SyncResolver sr = srEx.getSyncResolver();
197        //
198        // TODO: acceptChanges resolve persist DB
199        //      If the CRS value is persisted, then all correct.
200        //      If DB values persisted, then still dirty.
201        //
202        boolean persistDB = Boolean.FALSE;
203        Utils.processConflict(System.err, sr, crs, false);
204
205        // HACK TODO: acceptChanges resolve persist DB
206        //      There are still issues if the DB was selected.
207        //      After the exception, if the user does
208        //      cancel row update, then the value reverts
209        //      to what's in the CRS, which is probably NOT
210        //      what's in the DB. There is no indication that
211        //      there's a difference. But maybe it's not really
212        //      a problem because if the DB is async changed,
213        //      there's no indication.
214        //
215        //      Could have a "diff" button, or maybe keep
216        //      the row as "changed", and then the "diff"
217        //      just sends it all back.
218        //
219        //      Maybe set a visible state/status indicating that
220        //      the CRS should be reloaded from the database.
221        //
222
223        ResetRowPosition rrp = new ResetRowPosition(resultSet, currentRow);
224        if (persistDB)
225          throw new SQLException("These value not persisted");
226        if (rrp.ex != null)
227          throw rrp.ex;
228        break;
229      }
230      // if AfterChanges...:w
231      // if AfterChanges...:w
232    }
233
234    if (tryCount > maxTry && srEx != null)
235      throw srEx;
236  }

238  /**
239   * Deletes the current row from this {@linkplain ResultSet} and from the
240   * underlying database. Handle CachedRowSet.
241   * @param resultSet
242   * @throws SQLException
243   */
244  public static void deleteRow(ResultSet resultSet) throws SQLException {
245    resultSet.deleteRow();
246    if (!(resultSet instanceof CachedRowSet crs))
247      return;
248
249    logger.log(DEBUG, "using CachedRowSet");
250    try {
251      RowSetState.acceptCachedRowSetChanges(crs);
252    } catch (SyncProviderException ex) {
253      crs.undoDelete();
254      throw ex;
255    }
256  }

297  /**
298   * Determine if the specified column is nullable. If the nullability
299   * of the column is unknown, then an empty Optional is returned.
300   * @param resultSet RowSet on which to operate
301   * @param columnIndex column index
302   * @return Optional of true if nullable, empty Optional if unknown.
303   */
304  public static Optional<Boolean> isNullable(ResultSet resultSet, int columnIndex) {
305    try {
306      int nullable = resultSet.getMetaData().isNullable(columnIndex);
307      return nullable == ResultSetMetaData.columnNullableUnknown
308          ? Optional.empty()
309          : Optional.of(nullable == ResultSetMetaData.columnNullable);
310    } catch (SQLException ex) {
311      logger.log(ERROR, () -> sf("SQL Exception for column %d.", columnIndex, ex));
312      return Optional.empty();
313    }
314  }
315
316  /**
317   * Determine if the specified column is nullable. If the nullability
318   * of the column is unknown, then an empty Optional is returned.
319   * @param resultSet RowSet on which to operate
320   * @param columnName column name
321   * @return Optional of true if nullable, empty Optional if unknown.
322   */
323  public static Optional<Boolean> isNullable(ResultSet resultSet, String columnName) {
324    try {
325      return isNullable(resultSet, getColumnIndex(resultSet, columnName));
326    } catch (SQLException ex) {
327      logger.log(ERROR, () -> sf("SQL Exception for column %s.", columnName, ex));
328      return Optional.empty();
329    }
330  }

477  /**
478   * Fetch the current raw value from the database, the undo/redo stack is
479   * not referenced; use columnReader if available.
480   * Initial capture for undo/redo uses this method.
481   *
482   * @param rsc
483   * @return
484   * @throws SQLException
485   */
486  public static Object getColumnDirect(RSC rsc) throws SQLException {
487    Objects.requireNonNull(rsc);
488
489    if (rsc instanceof SsComponent comp) {
490      DbSupport.DbReader<RowSet, Integer, SsComponent> columnReader = comp.getColumnReader();
491      if (columnReader != null)
492        return comp.getColumnReader().apply(comp.getRowSet(), comp.getColumnIndex(), comp);
493    }
494
495    return rsc.getRowSet().getObject(rsc.getColumnIndex());
496  }

504  /**
505   * Get the column text from the current undo/redo value.
506   * @param comp this components rowset/column text
507   * @return
508   */
509  public static String getColumnObjectText(RSC comp) {
510    final RowSet rowSet = comp.getRowSet();
511    final String columnName = comp.getColumnName();
512
513    String value = null;
514    try {
515      // IF THE COLUMN IS NULL SO RETURN NULL
516      if (getColumnCount(rowSet) == 0) {
517        return null;
518      }
519
520      Object objectValue = UndoRedo.isUndoRedoEnabled(comp)
521                               ? UndoRedo.fetchCurrentChange(comp).value()
522                               : comp.getRowSet().getObject(comp.getColumnIndex());
523      if (objectValue == null)
524        return null;
525
526      if (objectValue instanceof String s)
527        return s;
528
529      final JDBCType jdbcType = getJDBCType(getColumnType(rowSet, columnName));
530
531      // clang-format off
532      switch (jdbcType) {
533        // the CHAR... cases already handled, but...
534        case INTEGER, SMALLINT, TINYINT, BIGINT,
535            REAL, DOUBLE, FLOAT, NUMERIC, DECIMAL,
536            BIT, BOOLEAN,
537            CHAR, VARCHAR, LONGVARCHAR, NCHAR, NVARCHAR, LONGNVARCHAR ->
538          value = objectValue.toString();
539        case DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP -> value = DateTime.getDateTimeText(objectValue, comp);
540        default -> // TODO: SSSQLExceptionUnhandledType
541          logger.log(ERROR,
542              () -> "Unsupported data type of " + jdbcType.getName() + " for column "
543                  + columnName + ".");
544      } // end switch
545      // clang-format on
546
547      //
548      // TODO: Convert this to use java.time.LocalDate, LocalTime,
549      //         or LocalDateTime as needed.
550      //
551
552    } catch (final SQLException se) {
553      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception for column " + columnName + ".", se);
554    }
555
556    return value;
557
558  } // end protected String getColumnObjectText(RowSet rs, String _columnName) {

560  /**
561   * Returns the Object from the rowset's specified column;
562   * no object conversion.
563   * There is no filtering, for example null conversion.
564   * @param comp component
565   * @return value
566   * @throws java.sql.SQLException
567   * @see <a href="https://download.oracle.com/otn-pub/jcp/jdbc-4_3-mrel3-eval-spec/jdbc4.3-fr-spec.pdf">JDBC 4.3 Specification</a> Appendix B-1
568   */
569  public static Object getColumnObject(RSC comp) throws SQLException {
570    return UndoRedo.isUndoRedoEnabled(comp) ? UndoRedo.fetchCurrentChange(comp).value()
571                                            : comp.getRowSet().getObject(comp.getColumnIndex());
572  }

577  /**
578   * Returns an Object of the specified type
579   * representing the value in the component's bound database column.
580   * This may involve a conversion.
581   * <p>
582   * Note that if a String type is specified, a null is not automatically
583   * turned into "" use getColumnObjectText for that.
584   * @param <T> type to return
585   * @param comp component
586   * @param type Class of returned type
587   * @return object
588   * @throws java.sql.SQLException
589   */
590  public static <T> T getColumnObject(RSC comp, Class<T> type) throws SQLException {
591    // If there are no columns, return null.
592    if (getColumnCount(comp.getRowSet()) == 0)
593      return null;
594
595    if (Boolean.TRUE) {
596      //return getColumnObject1(comp, type); // undo/redo,convert
597      Object objectValue = getColumnObject(comp);
598      return convertToType(objectValue, type);
599    } else
600      return RowSetOps_NOT_USED.getColumnObject2(comp, type); // getObject direct
601  }

621  /**
622   *
623   * @param comp
624   * @return
625   */
626  public static Array getColumnArray(SsComponent comp) {
627    try {
628      if (getColumnCount(comp.getRowSet()) == 0)
629        return null;
630      return (UndoRedo.isUndoRedoEnabled(comp) ? (Array) UndoRedo.fetchCurrentChange(comp).value()
631                                               : comp.getRowSet().getArray(comp.getColumnIndex()));
632    } catch (SQLException ex) {
633      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception for column " + comp.getColumnName() + ".", ex);
634    }
635    return null;
636  }

659  /**
660   * DEBUG ASSIST: Use this to force "n" acceptChanges conflicts after
661   * modifying a character column in the database.
662   * Only works with CachedRowSet and after
663   * {@linkplain #updateColumnText(dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SSComponent, java.lang.String)}.
664   */
665  public static class ForceConflict {
666    /** Atomic just in case */
667    private final AtomicInteger nForce;
668
669    /**
670     * Argument is number of conflicts to create.
671     * @param n
672     */
673    public ForceConflict(int n) {
674      nForce = new AtomicInteger(n);
675    }
676
677    /**
678     * Argument is number of conflicts to add.
679     * @param n
680     */
681    public void force(int n) {
682      if (n < 0)
683        throw new IllegalArgumentException();
684      nForce.getAndAdd(n);
685    }
686    /**
687     * Check if conflict should be forced. If this returns true,
688     * the nForce counter is decremented.
689     * Return true to force a conflict
690     */
691    boolean doForce() {
692      int n = nForce.getAndUpdate((val) -> (val > 0 ? val - 1 : 0));
693      return n != 0;
694    }
695  }

697  /**
698   * If enabled, modifify the database table associated with comp using a different
699   * ResultSet forcing a conflict. The modification is to comp's current row
700   * with a different value. Does nothing if not a String column.
701   * @param comp
702   * @param updatedValue current value for the component
703   * @throws SQLException
704   */
705  @SuppressWarnings("UseOfSystemOutOrSystemErr")
706  public static void checkForceConflict(SsComponent comp, String updatedValue) throws SQLException {
707    // Only do this for strings.
708    if (jdbcTypeToClass(comp.getColumnJDBCType()) != String.class)
709      return;
710
711    ForceConflict fc = defLookup(ForceConflict.class);
712    if (fc == null || !fc.doForce())
713      return;
714
715    // Get a resultSet that is probably the same as the RowSet associated
716    // with the param comp.
717    Connection conn = SsUtils.dbSupport().getSharedConnection();
718    try (Statement statement
719         = conn.createStatement(ResultSet.TYPE_SCROLL_INSENSITIVE, ResultSet.CONCUR_UPDATABLE);
720         ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery(comp.getRowSet().getCommand());) {
721      //ResultSet rs = statement.getResultSet();
722      rs.absolute(comp.getRowSet().getRow());
723      System.err.printf("FORCE_CONFLICT: %s\n", rs.getObject(comp.getColumnIndex()));
724      rs.updateString(comp.getColumnIndex(), updatedValue + "_ForceConflict");
725      rs.updateRow();
726    }
727  }

729  /**
730   * This wraps a value written to the database. In some cases, especially
731   * for text columns, before writing a string is converted. DbUpdate
732   * holds the actual value, after conversion, written to the database.
733   * Also there is a special value, {@link #UPDATE_NULL}, used when
734   * {@link RowSet#updateNull(int)} is used to update the database.
735   * @param value The actual value written to the database
736   */
737  public record DbUpdate(Object value) {}
738  /** Indicates {@link RowSet#updateNull(int)} was used to update the database. */
739  public static DbUpdate UPDATE_NULL = new DbUpdate(JDBCType.NULL);

741  /**
742   * The String updatedValue is converted to an object and
743   * {@link RowSet#updateObject(int, java.lang.Object) }
744   * or {@link RowSet#updateNull(int) } is used.
745   * <p>
746   * When the user changes/edits the SwingSet column this method propagates the
747   * change to the RowSet. A separate call is required to flush/commit the change
748   * to the database.
749   *
750   * @param comp The SsComponent doing the update
751   * @param updatedValue string to be type-converted as needed and updated in
752   *                      underlying RowSet column
753   * @return actual item written to the database, throws if nothing written
754   * @throws SqlNullException thrown if null is not allowed
755   * @throws SQLException  thrown if a database error is encountered
756   * @throws NumberFormatException thrown if unable to parse a string to number format
757   */
758  public static DbUpdate updateColumnText(SsComponent comp, String updatedValue)
759      throws SqlNullException, SQLException, NumberFormatException {
760    checkForceConflict(comp, updatedValue); // TODO: This is only for debug
761
762    return updateColumnText(comp, comp.getRowSet(), updatedValue, comp.getColumnIndex(),
763                            comp.getAllowNull());
764  }

766  /**
767   * Method used by SwingSet component listeners to update the underlying
768   * RowSet.
769   * <p>
770   * When the user changes/edits the SwingSet column this method propagates the
771   * change to the RowSet. A separate call is required to flush/commit the change
772   * to the database.
773   *
774   * @param comp The SsComponent doing the update
775   * @param rowSet RowSet on which to operate
776   * @param updatedValue string to be type-converted as needed and updated in
777   *                      underlying RowSet column
778   * @param columnIndex   name of the database column
779   * @param allowNull   indicates if Component and underlying column can contain null values
780   * @throws SqlNullException thrown if null is not allowed
781   * @throws SQLException  thrown if a database error is encountered
782   * @throws NumberFormatException thrown if unable to parse a string to number format
783   * @see <a href="https://download.oracle.com/otn-pub/jcp/jdbc-4_3-mrel3-eval-spec/jdbc4.3-fr-spec.pdf">JDBC 4.3 Specification</a> Appendix B
784   */
785  // TODO: test this and conversions
786  private static DbUpdate updateColumnText(SsComponent comp, RowSet rowSet, String updatedValue,
787                                           int columnIndex, boolean allowNull)
788      throws SqlNullException, SQLException, NumberFormatException {
789    int row = logger.isLoggable(DEBUG) ? rowSet.getRow() : -1;
790    logger.log(DEBUG,
791               () -> sf("[%s] row %d. Update to: %s. Allow null? [%s]", comp.getColumnForLog(),
792                        row, updatedValue, allowNull));
793
794    JDBCType jdbcType = getJDBCType(getColumnType(rowSet, columnIndex));
795
796    if (!textUpdateOK.contains(jdbcType)) {
797      // TODO: internal error exception?
798      logger.log(ERROR, () -> "Unsupported data type of " + jdbcType.getName() + " for column "
799                            + comp.getColumnForLog() + ".");
800      throw new SqlUnhandledTypeException(sf("'%s' can't be used as text", jdbcType));
801    }
802
803    Object dbValue = null;
804    // On insert row, write null if updatedValue is null or empty string,
805    // and do not perform other checks.
806    // TODO: isBlank???
807    if ((updatedValue == null || updatedValue.isEmpty()) && RowSetState.isInserting(rowSet)) {
808      rowSet.updateNull(columnIndex);
809      return UPDATE_NULL;
810    }
811
812    /*
813     * FIRST - NULL HANDLING:
814     *
815     * For character-based columns where _allowNull==true, we write null rather than an empty string
816     * We do this because a column could allow null, but have a UNIQUE constraint and each null
817     * should be unique.
818     *
819     * We want to enter this code under 3 conditions:
820     *  1. updateColumnText() is passed a null string
821     *  2. updateColumnText() is passed an empty string (any column type)
822     *  3. updateColumnText() is passed a 'blank' (whitespace) string
823     *     for a non-character-based field (e.g., "" or "   " for a double)
824     *
825     * If !allowNull then a character based field with 0 or more blank spaced
826     * will be allowed and code will continue to the switch/case statement below.
827     */
828    if (updatedValue == null || updatedValue.isEmpty()
829        || (updatedValue.isBlank() && !textUpdateEmptyOK.contains(jdbcType))) {
830      if (allowNull) {
831        rowSet.updateNull(columnIndex);
832        return UPDATE_NULL;
833      } else if (!textUpdateEmptyOK.contains(jdbcType)) {
834        // This will throw an exception for a non-char type, but allow
835        // a char-based type with an empty string to continue to the
836        // switch/case below and write the empty string via
837        // rowSet.updateString(_columnName, _updatedValue)
838        //
839        // Note that if there is a UNIQUE constraint on such a text
840        // column then repeatedly writing the same number (0 to N)
841        // spaces should throw an SQL exception
842        // (as should any other duplicate string)
843
844        // TODO: Have a method "CreateMessage(RSC) see also
845        //       SSFormattedTextField, SSCommon
846        // NOTE: in following should mention column name
847        throw new SqlNullException("Null values are not allowed for this field.");
848      }
849    }
850    assert (updatedValue != null);
851
852    /*
853     * SECOND - update non-null values based on string conversions
854     */
855    switch (jdbcType) {
856        // clang-format off
857      case INTEGER, SMALLINT, TINYINT, BIGINT,
858          REAL, DOUBLE, FLOAT, DECIMAL, NUMERIC,
859          BOOLEAN, BIT,
860          CHAR, VARCHAR, LONGVARCHAR, NCHAR, NVARCHAR, LONGNVARCHAR ->
861        dbValue = convertToType(updatedValue, jdbcType);
862        //dbValue = updatedValue; // Let DB convert.
863      // clang-format on
864      case DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP -> // TODO: use convertObjectType when...
865        dbValue = getSQLDateTimeObject(updatedValue, comp);
866      default ->
867        // TODO: SSSQLExceptionUnhandledType
868        throw new IllegalStateException("switch cases out of sync");
869    } // end switch
870    rowSet.updateObject(columnIndex, dbValue);
871    return new DbUpdate(dbValue);
872  } // end protected void updateColumnText(String _updatedValue, String _columnName)

874  /**
875   * Method used by SwingSet component listeners to update the underlying
876   * RowSet.
877   * <p>
878   * When the user changes/edits the SwingSet column this method propagates the
879   * change to the RowSet. A separate call is required to flush/commit the change
880   * to the database.
881   *
882   * @param comp The SsComponent doing the update
883   * @param updatedValue value to write to underlying RowSet column
884   * @return actual item written to the database, throws if nothing written
885   * @throws SqlNullException thrown if null is not allowed
886   * @throws SQLException  thrown if a database error is encountered
887   */
888  public static DbUpdate updateColumnObject(SsComponent comp, Object updatedValue)
889      throws SqlNullException, SQLException, NumberFormatException {
890    if (updatedValue instanceof String s) {
891      // This method doesn't have all the string checks,
892      // use updateColumnText if String Object.
893      return updateColumnText(comp, s);
894    }
895    final RowSet rowSet = comp.getRowSet();
896    final int columnIndex = comp.getColumnIndex();
897    boolean allowNull = comp.getAllowNull();
898    logger.log(DEBUG, () -> comp.getColumnForLog() + " Update to: " + updatedValue
899                            + ". Allow null? [" + allowNull + "]");
900
901    Object dbValue;
902    // On insert row, write null and do not perform other checks.
903    if (updatedValue == null) {
904      if (RowSetState.isInserting(rowSet) || allowNull) {
905        rowSet.updateNull(columnIndex);
906        return UPDATE_NULL;
907      } else
908        throw new SqlNullException("NULL not allowed for this field.");
909    }
910
911    //_rowSet.updateObject(_columnIndex, _updatedValue);
912    JDBCType jdbcType = comp.getColumnJDBCType();
913    // TODO: Maybe a component field that says use jdbc conversion.
914    //       Better, checkDriverConvertToType(),
915    //       so "obj = convertObjectTypeIfNeeded(...)"
916    // TODO: Why isn't updateObject(index, object, type) used anywhere?
917    //       Could always catch SQLFeatureNotSupportedException and do
918    //       manual conversions as a last resort.
919    // TODO: It's weird that updateObject(idx,obj,type) javadoc says
920    //       "type to be sent to the database". Does that mean the specified
921    //       conversions for setObject kick in at that point?
922    dbValue = convertToType(updatedValue, jdbcType);
923    updateColumnObjectDirect(rowSet, columnIndex, dbValue, jdbcType);
924    return new DbUpdate(dbValue);
925  }

928   * Method used by SwingSet component listeners to update the underlying

931   * When the user changes/edits the SwingSet column this method propagates the
932   * change to the RowSet. A separate call is required to flush/commit the change

940   */

947  /**
948   * Method used by SwingSet component listeners to update the underlying
949   * RowSet.
950   * <p>
951   * When the user changes/edits the SwingSet column this method propagates the
952   * change to the RowSet. A separate call is required to flush/commit the change
953   * to the database.
954   *
955   * @param comp The SsComponent doing the update
956   * @param rowSet RowSet on which to operate
957   * @param dbValue Array
958   * @param columnName   name of the database column
959   * @param allowNull   indicates if Component and underlying column can contain null values
960   * @throws SqlNullException thrown if null is not allowed
961   * @throws SQLException  thrown if a database error is encountered
962   */
963  private static DbUpdate updateColumnArray(@SuppressWarnings("unused") SsComponent comp,
964                                            RowSet rowSet, Array dbValue, String columnName,
965                                            boolean allowNull)
966      throws SqlNullException, SQLException {
967    logger.log(
968        DEBUG,
969        () -> "[" + columnName + "]. Update to: " + dbValue + ". Allow null? [" + allowNull + "]");
970
971    // On insert row, write null if dbValue is null,
972    // and do not perform other checks.
973    if (dbValue == null && RowSetState.isInserting(rowSet)) {
974      rowSet.updateNull(columnName);
975      return UPDATE_NULL;
976    }
977
978    if (dbValue == null) {
979      if (allowNull) {
980        rowSet.updateNull(columnName);
981        return UPDATE_NULL;
982      } else
983        throw new SqlNullException("NULL not allowed for this field.");
984    }
985
986    rowSet.updateArray(columnName, dbValue);
987    return new DbUpdate(dbValue);
988  }
